evidence_boundary.claim: P0 tests only whether this frozen donor-series Program family has natural headroom and cohort selectivity/risk. It is not a deployable Capability, Source-to-Target transfer, or Harness evolution result.

protocol.candidate_binding: one donor's six rows x all 48 outputs
protocol.metric: per-series sMASE; unweighted cohort and dataset means
protocol.roster: existing exposed 12 donor + 8 evaluation series per dataset
protocol.selection: maximize exact grouped support gain over donor and dose; choose IDENTITY when the best non-identity gain is <= 0
protocol.support_query: alternating 4/4 folds, evaluated in both directions

scientific_question: Does one full donor-series action with a fixed 1/0.25/0 sample-weight menu expose natural cohort-conditioned grouped downstream headroom?
